description: Schema for deterministic per-file Lean4/clean frontend diagnostic artifacts consumed by generate_frontend_classification.py. The generator treats absent artifacts as missing evidence and present artifacts that violate this schema as stale_or_invalid evidence. Valid artifacts remain pending cross-check until compared against diagnostic_category and first_error_signature.

field_constraints.engine: must equal lean4 or clean and match the path engine segment
field_constraints.filename: must equal the corpus filename, including .lean
field_constraints.source_sha256: must equal the current sha256: digest from tests/lean4_compat/MANIFEST.json
field_constraints.command: must be a non-empty array of non-empty strings
field_constraints.diagnostic_category: must be null or a non-empty string; later cross-checks compare it with the generated diagnostic_category dimension
field_constraints.first_error_signature: must be null or a non-empty string; later cross-checks compare it with the generated first_error_signature dimension
field_constraints.diagnostics: must be an array of diagnostic objects; each object must include severity and message
field_constraints.diagnostics[].severity: must be error, warning, or information
field_constraints.diagnostics[].line: when present, must be an integer
field_constraints.diagnostics[].column: when present, must be an integer
